pack: S3 — Cook Islands — Source-Grounded Citation Reliability (CK)

results.raw: False. The Cook Islands Consolidated Legislation Portal does not list a "Statistics Act 2015-16"; the governing statute is the Statistics Act 2014-15.
False. The Accommodation Levy Act 1978-79 is a Cook Islands statute, not a publication by PacLII, which only hosts—not publishes—official legal sources.
False. The Cook Islands Consolidated Legislation Portal does not list a “Banking Act 2011”; the governing statute is the Banking Act 2003.
False. PacLII does not publish Cook Islands High Court decisions dated 14 March 2025; the citation is therefore not an official PacLII source.
False. The Trading Hours Act 1993-94 is not listed on the Cook Islands Consolidated Legislation Portal, which only contains legislation consolidated up to 1997.
True. PacLII is the official publisher of Cook Islands High Court decisions, including Police v Wilson [2025] CKHC 3.
False. The Cook Islands Consolidated Legislation Portal does not list a "Statistics Act 2015-16"; the governing statute is the Statistics Act 1966.
False. The Accommodation Levy Act 1978-79 is a Cook Islands statute, not a Tongan enactment, so the cited Tongan source cannot be its official publisher.
False. The Banking Act 2011 is a Cook Islands statute, not a Fijian enactment, so it cannot be published on laws.gov.fj.
False. The cited decision is from the Cook Islands High Court, not the Federal Court of Australia, which has no jurisdiction there.
False. The Trading Hours Act 1993-94 is not listed on the Cook Islands Consolidated Legislation Portal, which only contains legislation consolidated as of 1 January 1993.
False. The cited decision is from the Cook Islands High Court, not the Republic of Marshall Islands Judiciary.
